blocks.text: Jab A site par stop codon aata hai to koi aminoacyl-tRNA A site par nahin aata, kyun ke stop codons ka koi anticodon nahin hota. A site par stop codon ko release factor naam ka protein pehchanta hai. Yeh P site wale tRNA se polypeptide ko azaad kar deta hai, aur yun translation khatam ho jati hai. tRNA bhi ribosome se chhoot jata hai aur ribosomal subunits mRNA se alag ho jati hain.

blocks.alt: Aik qataar mein teen khaane, teeron se jure. Baen: ribosome jis ki P site mein UGG par tRNA (anticodon ACC) Met-Leu-Ser-Trp zanjeer thaame hai aur A site mein stop codon UAA; release factor qareeb aa raha. Beech: release factor A site mein, polypeptide tRNA se azad. Daen: polypeptide, bari subunit, chhoti subunit, tRNA aur release factor mRNA se alag.

blocks.prompt: mRNA AUG UUU GGC UAA hai. Polypeptide mein kitne amino acids honge, aur zanjeer ko kaun rokta hai?
blocks.explanation: Teen amino acids: methionine (AUG), phenylalanine (UUU) aur glycine (GGC). UAA stop codon hai; A site par is ko release factor pehchaan kar polypeptide ko azaad kar deta hai.
